Terminal entry point loads dotenv in main and runs the shared chat loop without configuring OTel providers.
Python app.py and Python agent.py documented in README; requirements.txt dependencies; no pinned runtime.

findings.title: Workflow turns lack duration and failure outcome metrics
findings.gap: The workflow span is present, but run_turn exits on model/tool failure before setting workflow error status, failed call aggregates, or any workflow duration metric.
findings.impact: Operators can see a child error span but cannot chart workflow latency or distinguish a failed turn from a successful workflow at the workflow boundary.
findings.product_outcome: Operators should see one workflow duration and outcome for every SmashBot turn, including failed turns.
findings.required_fix: Record gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration for every turn and set workflow ERROR plus bounded error.type when a child operation fails. Record call aggregates on all exits and keep them on the owning workflow span. Also enrich this existing workflow span with applicable redacted typed gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages from actual run_turn inputs/reply; system-role instructions remain in messages because they are not separately supplied. Set capture mode redacted before export with limits of 16 messages, 64 parts/message, 8192 UTF-8 bytes/content attribute; prove sentinel absence and value equality. Preserve the source-provided conversation ID from the web session as gen_ai.conversation.id on the workflow span (span-only; omit in CLI when unavailable). Snapshot ordered input messages before run_turn mutates the list, sanitize before export, and set gen_ai.output.messages only from the actual returned reply. For structured GenAI attributes on the observed OTel Python span API, construct valid typed values, sanitize first, then compact-JSON serialize before span.set_attribute; keep operation and sampler-relevant identity fields available in start_as_current_span attributes=. Use the proposed shared `genai_content.py:sanitize_genai_content(...)` for all applicable content before any OTel span attribute/exporter; this source hook is not implemented yet.
evidence: otel_setup.py; app.py; chat_core.py (source only; no captured runtime evidence supplied)
acceptance_criteria: Failed turns set ERROR and error.type on invoke_workflow smashbot_turn.
LLM/tool call counts include failed calls and remain on the workflow span, not the HTTP root span.

On successful turns, same workflow span has sanitized input messages equal to the ordered values received by run_turn and output messages equal to the returned reply; on failed turns, output is absent. The proposed shared `genai_content.py:sanitize_genai_content(...)` redacts before any OTel span attribute/exporter and stays within 16 messages, 64 parts/message, and 8192 UTF-8 bytes/content attribute.

When the web runtime supplies its opaque session ID, the workflow span carries that source value as gen_ai.conversation.id; no new ID is created, and no ID is placed in metric dimensions or span names. The captured input is the pre-mutation ordered snapshot.

Probe the span creator/on_start path separately: operation and stable identity fields are present at creation, while later content enrichment remains on the same span; decode JSON-string content and compare exact sanitized values.

environments.surface: SmashBot Flask app, CLI, and shared chat core
environments.runner: python3 app.py for web runtime; python3 agent.py for CLI runtime; python3 historical_check.py for focused fake-client signals
environments.prerequisites: Python and requirements installed; use the existing fake OpenAI client/test seam and isolated process environments for provider/endpoint branches. No live OpenAI key or credits are required for focused call-site tests. A local Splunk Observability Studio receiver is only needed for local-delivery proof; in-memory providers can prove signal shape without network credentials. For endpoint/protocol checks, start an isolated OTLP/HTTP fixture on 127.0.0.1:14318; do not query Studio from application startup. The normally advertised Studio receiver remains 127.0.0.1:4318.

scenarios.trigger: A model or tool failure exits run_turn before normal aggregation.
scenarios.expected_signals: invoke_workflow smashbot_turn span ERROR with error.type, gen_ai.invoke_workflow.duration, and call counts that include failed calls.
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Workflow span is ERROR and ends on all paths; duration is recorded once; call counts include provider/tool failures and remain on the workflow rather than the HTTP root span.

scenarios.trigger: Run one successful turn with ordered system/user/tool history and a fake provider response.
scenarios.expected_signals: Existing invoke_workflow smashbot_turn span with sanitized gen_ai.input.messages from the pre-mutation input snapshot, gen_ai.output.messages from the returned reply, and gen_ai.conversation.id only when source-provided.
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Decode current typed-parts JSON and compare to actual pre-mutation input and returned reply after redaction. Preserve message order and tool-call identity; enforce max 16 messages, 64 parts/message, 8192 UTF-8 bytes/content attribute; assert sensitive sentinel absent from span attributes/events and exporter payload. Use start_as_current_span attributes= to prove sampling-relevant operation/identity values reach creation; serialize nested message/document structures as valid compact JSON strings after redaction, then decode and compare.
